Name: Villager Exile - Evict Villagers and Invite Them Back
Author: GoldBrickMods
Description:
Is there a villager you'd rather not see around town? Buy an Eviction Notice at the Mayor's Office and hand it to them. The next morning they've moved to Zuzu City. You can bring them back whenever you like: nothing is deleted from your save, and their friendship with you is frozen while they're away.

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Click the ledger book on Lewis's desk to open the Mayor's Office. The Eviction Notice costs 5,000g and goes on sale once the Community Center or the Joja warehouse is complete.[/*]
[*]Hold the notice and talk to the villager. They react in a short scene (every villager from the base game has their own line), then leave the next morning.[/*]
[*]Lewis sends you a letter saying they moved to Zuzu City. Their family loses 2 hearts with you and their friends lose 1, and a few of them will bring it up when you talk to them.[/*]
[*]To bring someone back, buy a Welcome Back Letter (also 5,000g), use it and pick who to invite. They return the next morning, and half of the lost hearts come back.[/*]
[/list]You can also pick villagers with checkboxes in Generic Mod Config Menu, or with the exile and unexile console commands. Those work right away.

[size=4][b]While they're gone[/b][/size]
These are the defaults. Most of them can be turned off in the config.
[list]
[*]Apart from visit days, they don't appear in the valley, or on the social tab, the calendar or the NPC Map Locations map.[/*]
[*]Their heart events and cutscenes don't play. They aren't marked as seen, so you still get them if the villager comes back. Story cutscenes like the Community Center or Joja warehouse completion still play.[/*]
[*]Letters they would have sent you are held and delivered when they return.[/*]
[*]Other villagers stop using everyday lines that mention them.[/*]
[*]They don't post help wanted quests, visit Ginger Island or count for the Introductions quest.[/*]
[*]They still come back for festivals and on family birthdays with "just visiting" lines. They're only around for the day, but you can talk to them, and friendship changes as normal.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Who can't be evicted[/b][/size]
Your spouse or roommate, anyone an active quest or special order needs, and the villagers the story depends on, for example Lewis, Robin, Pierre, Gus, Clint, Willy, Marnie, the Wizard, Krobus, Pam and Sandy (the full list is in config.json). A config option allows them anyway, but shops and progress can break until they're back.

[size=4][b]Known issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]If one of the 12 Flower Dance dancers is exiled, they still dance when they visit. The game hardcodes the dance and crashes without six pairs, so swapping someone in isn't safe.[/*]
[*]Festivals and events from other mods that are written in code (not Content Patcher) may still show them.[/*]
[*]A festival whose main event needs an exiled villager may not run normally. For example, with Willy exiled (only possible with the story-villager option) there's no Festival of Ice fishing contest.[/*]
[*]Mail Framework Mod letters and unsigned letters aren't held back.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and adds the in-game checkboxes and settings.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.2 on Windows.[/*]
[*]Single player is tested. Co-op hasn't been tested: in multiplayer the host decides who is exiled, and each player needs the mod to see the notices, letters and menus.[/*]
[*]Written to work alongside SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, NPC Map Locations and Social Page Order Redux, though not every combination has been tested. Modded villagers can be evicted too, with general lines.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Removing it[/b][/size]
As the host, run exile_cleanup in the SMAPI console to remove any unused notices and letters, sleep so the game saves, and only then delete the VillagerExile folder. Letters from exiled villagers that the mod was holding stay in your mailbox. Lewis's letters and the notices belong to the mod and go with it. Exiled villagers come back on their own within two days, and hearts lost with their family and friends stay lost.

[size=4][b]Works with my other mods[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55005]Hard Mode Economy[/url]: the notices and letters are sold in its Mayor's Office, and their price scales with its costs.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55006]Spouse Keeps Routine[/url]: your spouse skips the homes and hangouts of exiled villagers and mentions evictions in the evening.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]For modders[/b][/size]
There's an API to check who is exiled or visiting, who left or came back today, and which locations to avoid. Get it after GameLaunched with helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IVillagerExileApi>("Goldm.VillagerExile"). Values are reliable on the host; farmhands get IsExiled and GetExiledNpcs.
[spoiler]
[code]public interface IVillagerExileApi
{
    bool IsExiled(string npcName);              // exiled now and not visiting today
    string[] GetExiledNpcs();                   // every exiled NPC, including visitors
    bool IsVisiting(string npcName);            // exiled but visiting today
    string[] GetEvictedToday();                 // left this morning
    string[] GetReturnedToday();                // came back this morning
    string[] GetAvoidLocations(string npcName); // home plus schedule stops
}[/code][/spoiler]

Report bugs on the Bugs tab. Thanks for the endorsements, and for any tips on [url=https://ko-fi.com/goldbrick]Ko-fi[/url].
